data.body: **P3 — Attach cleanup diagnostics to the failure that will reach the caller.** Large-result checkpoint failures naturally arrive as `CompletionException`; this combines the end-hook error onto that wrapper, but `execute()` later unwraps it and throws its cause, silently losing the suppressed cleanup failure. Normalize the preparation failure before combining, or transfer suppressed failures to the unwrapped cause, and cover a completion-wrapped nonfatal preparation failure plus an end-hook `Error`.
